query:
SELECT
                em.meal_id as "meal_id!",
                em.recipe_id,
                r.name as recipe_name,
                p.name as place,
                em.servings,
                em.start_time as "start_time: time::OffsetDateTime"
            FROM event_meals em
            JOIN recipes r ON r.recipe_id = em.recipe_id
            JOIN places p ON p.place_id = em.place_id
            WHERE em.event_id = $1
            ORDER BY em.start_time, r.name
